sections.h2: Chesapeake Beach Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 120 residential sales closed in Chesapeake Beach (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $550,000, above the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 20 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Chesapeake Beach sales closed between $385,000 and $751,175, or about $312 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($563,000, 63 sales) was about 7% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($525,000, 57 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Chesapeake Beach
sections.html:
25% of the sales were detached homes and 75% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,771 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,384 to 2,224 square feet. 42% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1974 and 2023, with a median year built of 1989.

Averages hide a lot, so Chris Jenkins compares you to homes that match yours on street, size, age and condition rather than to the whole Chesapeake Beach median.
